scripts.dev: npm run build -w @2p/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @2p/server" "npm run dev -w @2p/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @2p/shared && npm run build -w @2p/server && npm run build -w @2p/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @2p/shared && npm run typecheck -w @2p/server && npm run typecheck -w @2p/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
